programme.title: Platoon
programme.desc: Inspired by Oliver Stone's own experiences, this anti-war epic tells the tale of PFC Chris Taylor (Charlie Sheen), an Army recruit sent to Vietnam, who witnesses the atrocities of war – many of which are carried out by his comrades.

programme.title: Home Of The Brave
programme.desc: When a humanitarian mission in Iraq is derailed by an explosive ambush, a chaotic battle ensues leaving a small band of U.S. soldiers forever changed.

programme.title: Valkyrie
programme.desc: Based on the true story of Colonel Claus von Stauffenberg (Tom Cruise) and his assassination plot targeting Adolph Hitler, this engrossing thriller reenacts the daring operation to eliminate one of the most evil tyrants the world has ever known.

programme.title: Windtalkers
programme.desc: John Woo directs this epic, action-packed drama about a WW II soldier (Nicolas Cage) assigned to protect a Navajo soldier (Adam Beach)...and the secret code he knows. Christian Slater, Roger Willie, Peter Stormare and Mark Ruffalo also star.

programme.title: The Man In The Iron Mask
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio leads a phenomenal cast in this thrilling tale of majesty and Musketeers. When the excesses of France's arrogant King Louis XIV begin to threaten his subjects' very lives, the legendary Musketeers reunite to save their country!

programme.title: The Bounty
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins delivers a brilliant portrayal as William Bligh, the sea captain who, in 1787, steered The Bounty on a 27,000-mile voyage into danger, chaos and madness, and whose first mate (Mel Gibson) lead a legendary mutiny against him..

programme.title: The Barbarians
programme.desc: It is in the time of dragons, witchcraft and sorcery! An evil ruler enslaves a beautiful young queen and she bears him three children. Years later, with the help of a wild young barbarian outlaw woman, her twin sons set out to free their mother.

programme.title: Masters Of The Universe
programme.desc: The evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) is poised to conquer the universe. But fear not! He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) has declared war on Skeletor, and the battle between good and evil has come to Earth. Courtney Cox also stars in the epic, action-adventure.

programme.title: Hercules (1983)
programme.desc: Created by Zeus from the energy of a thousand suns, armed with the strength of a hundred men, Hercules triumphs over the forces of darkness in this thrilling adventure that's bigger than the myth itself! Stars Lou Ferrigno and Sybil Danning.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Hercules
programme.desc: Lou Ferrigno returns as Hercules, the man with the strength of a hundred! When Zeus' seven mighty thunderbolts are stolen by a group of traitorous goddesses, it's up to Hercules to save the universe from chaos! William Berger also stars.

programme.title: Hercules (2014)
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson stars as the most towering myth of all time, revealing the man behind the legend in this bold reimaging of the famed Hercules!

programme.title: Cherry 2000
programme.desc: In this fun, futuristic sci-fi adventure, Melanie Griffith ("Something Wild") is delightful and unflappable as a bounty hunter on a mission to find a robot replicant of a rich man's short-circuited wife.

programme.title: WarGames (1983)
programme.desc: When computer hacker David Lightman (Matthew Broderick) unwittingly taps into the Defense Department's war computer, he initiates a confrontation of global proportions -- World War III -- and must race against time to prevent a nuclear Armageddon!

programme.title: Stargate
programme.desc: Set against the wondrous backdrop of the Great Pyramids, "Stargate" tells the story of two very different men (Kurt Russell, James Spader) who join forces to unravel the mystery of a curious artifact which could reveal the origin of civilization.

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic thriller, a mega-villain (Malcolm McDowell, "The Passage") controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl (Lori Petty, "Cadillac Man") and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

programme.title: Cotton Comes To Harlem
programme.desc: Two detectives find themselves on a wild goose chase for stolen cash that takes them from the Apollo Theater through the heart and soul of Harlem!

programme.title: Across 110th Street
programme.desc: When Harlem gangsters mess with the Mafia, an unlikely pair of New York's finest must work together to bring justice to the streets!

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: A boxer on-the-rise is asked to throw a fight by the local mob that has figured prominently in his success.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) grows up to become the reigning head of Harlem's black mafia.

programme.title: Bucktown
programme.desc: Fred Williamson and Pam Grier star in this tense action drama about a man who comes to Bucktown to bury his slain brother.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Action legends return to the genre that made them famous in this big, brassy and action-packed tale!

programme.title: Hoodlum
programme.desc: In New York of the 1920s, three rival gang leaders (Laurence Fishhburne, Tim Roth and Andy Garcia) battle for control of Harlem's urban power.

programme.title: Fled
programme.desc: Two prison escapees on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk.

programme.title: Diggstown
programme.desc: James Woods and Louis Gossett, Jr. are a potent one-two punch as a con man and an over-the-hill boxer out to scam Bruce Dern out of a small fortune!

programme.title: State Of Grace
programme.desc: An undercover cop (Sean Penn) comes back to his old neighborhood in Hell's Kitchen to bring down the Irish Mafia.

programme.title: Blow Out
programme.desc: While taping wind effects, a sound man inadvertently records a presidential hopeful's fatal car crash.

programme.title: Kalifornia
programme.desc: A couple (David Duchovny, Michelle Forbes) sets out on a cross-country trip to research a book about serial killers and, along the way, pick up an ex-con and his girlfriend (Brad Pitt, Juliette Lewis) who take them on a ride they'll never forget.

programme.title: Body Of Evidence
programme.desc: After a night of unbridled passion, Rebecca Carlson (Madonna) finds herself on trial for murder. Now it's up to her attorney (Willem Dafoe) to prove her innocence...but the road to the truth may prove to have as many curves as his seductive client!

programme.title: The Thomas Crown Affair (1968)
programme.desc: Sophisticated, handsome Thomas Crown (Steve McQueen) is the intellect behind a bank robbery so stunning, it has Boston's finest completely baffled. Faye Dunaway is the sleek and smart insurance investigator out to bring him in.

programme.title: The Thomas Crown Affair (1999)
programme.desc: In this sizzling action film, when thrill-seeking billionaire Thomas Crown (Pierce Brosnan) ingeniously steals a priceless painting from a museum, he's pitted against the beautiful insurance investigator (Rene Russo) hired to retrieve the artwork.

programme.title: Scorpio
programme.desc: Two spies thrust together by political forces beyond their control find themselves fighting for their live amidst the brutality of the Cold War!

programme.title: American Ninja
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff stars as Joe Armstrong, a one-man fighting machine. Serving in the army to avoid prison, Joe finds himself battling the deadly Black Star Order, as well as corrupt military leaders in order to bring down an illegal arms sale.

programme.title: American Ninja 2: The Confrontation
programme.desc: In this action-packed sequel, Joe Armstrong and Curtis Jackson are sent to the Caribbean in search of missing Marines. But they must first battle scientifically engineered Super Ninjas to bring down a dreaded drug lord known as The Lion!

programme.title: American Ninja 3: Blood Hunt
programme.desc: Martial artist David Bradley takes the reins as Sean Davidson in this third installment of the wildly popular "American Ninja" franchise, teaming up with Steve James to battle a maniacal terrorist in yet another explosive action-packed adventure!

programme.title: American Ninja 4: The Annihilation
programme.desc: Michael Dudikoff is back in action in this thrilling sequel! Teamed up with CIA operative Sean Davidson (David Bradley), Joe Armstrong (Dudikoff) returns to help foil the plans of a terrorist (James Booth) hell-bent on annihilating New York City.

programme.title: Missing In Action
programme.desc: American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam – and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris.
